name: SmolDocling-256M-preview
rationale: Cross-family P2 fast-iteration anchor (256M params; SigLIP + SmolLM2 backbone — different vendor than Qwen-VL family). If even this small model cap-hits on prior CUDA-positive docs, the 'halt failure is generic transformer-VLM' hypothesis gets strong support. If it does NOT cap-hit, the more-likely interpretation is the emergent threshold is above 256M — informs whether to schedule Qwen3-VL-8B / InternVL3-8B next.
